_doc: Where each register permit's skyline comes from: the cell of OSM buildings it was measured against (cellBuildings: how many the cell held with a height), and from where (observer: its point, or the pavement and how far from the point, src/lib/shadows/observer.ts). The buildings are those of the extract named; the heights follow heightRule. docs/plan-data-lineage.md in solstice.
heightRule: height tag, else building:levels x 3.1 m (matches Mapbox), else the median of tagged buildings near
